label: ECB Data Portal (SDMX time series)
terms_note: European Central Bank statistical data, SDMX 2.1 REST web service, public and keyless. Responses are SDMX-ML (XML) by default.

get_series.note: series_id is '<flowRef>/<key>' naming ONE series, e.g. EXR/D.USD.EUR.SP00.A (daily USD per EUR reference rate) or FM/M.U2.EUR.4F.KR.MRR_FR.LEV. start/end are ISO dates or SDMX periods (2024-01, 2024-Q1). Without start the whole history is returned. A key matching no series is a 404. The Accept header pins SDMX-ML generic data (XML): the API content-negotiates and would answer SDMX-JSON to application/json, and its format= parameter does not override Accept.

not_offered.me: Public statistical API without accounts or keys.
not_offered.get_candles: Statistical time series only; no OHLC market candles.
not_offered.search_symbols: The API lists dataflows (GET /service/dataflow) but offers no search over series keys.
not_offered.get_news: No news in the statistical data API.
